snippet.title: Ve Junoon | Awarapan 2 | Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani | Vishesh Bhatt | Mithoon, Sayeed Q., Subodhh
snippet.description:
Phir ishq karne chala kyun?
 
Beginning the musical journey of ‘Awarapan 2’, ‘Ve Junoon’ is composed by Mithoon, sung by Subodhh Sharma and penned by Sayeed Quadri. Featuring Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video, this song is yearning in its purest form.
 
#VeJunoon #Awarapan2 #EmraanHashmi #DishaPatani #Mithoon #SayeedQuadri #SubodhhSharma
 
Song Composed and Arranged by Mithoon
Lyrics: Sayeed Quadri
Singer: Subodhh Sharma
Song Creative Head: Anugrah
Music Production: Godswill Mergulhão
Music Assistants: Anugrah, Godswill Mergulhão, Eli Rodrigues & Kaushal Gohil
Guitars: Kalyan Baruah
Violin: Jitu Thakur
Backing Vocals: Abhishek Nailwal, Mihir Sharma & Kaustubh More
Recorded at Livingwater Music by A Manivannan
Song Mixed & Mastered by Eric Pillai at Future Sound of Bombay
Assistant Mixing Engineer: Michael Edwin Pillai
Music Head Vishesh Films: Rohit Saini
 
Starring Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, Shabana Azmi, Suvinder Vicky, Vijayant Kohli, Aniruddh Rawal, Atul Kumar
 
Vishesh Films & Mukesh Bhatt Present
A Vishesh Bhatt Production
 
AWARAPAN 2
Produced By Vishesh Bhatt
Directed By Nitin Kakkar
Director of Photography Vishnu Rao
Editor Devendra Murdeshwar
Production Designer Teena Paradkar
Choreographer Mudassar Khan
 
Theatrical Distribution Pen Marudhar
In Cinemas 14th August 2026
 
Lyrics:

Intro
 
Chaha tha tune jisse Paaya kabhi na usse
 
Tujhko toh sab hai pataa, aye dil Saari khabar hai tujhe
 
Banjar hui hai aankhen Veeran hai ye saansen
Ab meri rooh ko na jalaa...naa jalaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil lutne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye Phir Ishq karne chala kyun…
 
( Music )
 
OOOOOOOOOO.. OOOOOOOOOO..
 
Verse 1
 
Dekha hai pehle kahin Aisa laga kyun usse
 
Shaayad mere dard se kahin Waqif laga woh mujhe
 
Marham laga zakhmon pe Raahat mili kuchh phirse
Dil ko sukoon milaa..haan milaaaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun, haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun…
 
(Music)
 
Tararareiyeee yeeeeee…
 
Verse 2
 
Aisi koi daastaan
Hai dil main uske kahin Zikr woh jiska kabhi magar Khud se bhi karta nahin
 
Rakhta chhupa ke sabse Bhulaa hai jaise rakh ke
Kal woh kahin apna…..apnaaa Aage hai teri marzi
 
Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun….haaye
 
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
 
Dil ishq karne chalaa kyun Hmmmmmm…..
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun

snippet.title: Massacre Song | Music Video | ALPHA | Alia Bhatt, Sharvari | Rohansh & Abeer, Shilpa, Jonita, Kausar
snippet.description:
Two deadly girls, one banger music video. Presenting #Massacre - the music video! 🔥🔥🔥

snippet.description:
Dil Majboor Ho Gya – Aarzoo Khaan | Emotional Hindi Sad Song | New Song 2026 | Arijit Singh Vibe


---



Dil majboor ho gya...
teri mohabbat ke saamne.

Bahut chaha tha
khud ko sambhalna...
magar tera naam aate hi
ye dil phir se toot jaata hai.

Hum jaante the
ye ishq dard dega...
phir bhi dil ne
sirf tumhe hi chuna.

“Dil Majboor Ho Gya”
ek aise dil ki kahani hai
jo mohabbat me
apni har had se guzar gaya...
aur phir bhi wafa karta raha.

Kuch rishte
kismat me nahi hote...
magar dil unhe
bhool bhi nahi paata.

Is gaane mein
mohabbat bhi hai,
judai bhi hai,
aur ek gehra ehsaas bhi
jo dheere se kehta hai —

dil majboor ho gya...
teri chahat me kho gaya...

Agar aapne bhi
kabhi kisi ko
apni rooh se zyada chaha ho
aur uski yaadon se kabhi azaad na ho paaye ho,
to ye gaana
aapke dil ko chhoo jaayega.

❤प्रिय मित्रों❤ हम सबका सदैव मंगल करने वाली श्री हनुमान चालीसा के 5०० करोड़ 5 बिलियन व्यूज पूरे हो गए हैं 🙏ये केवल आप ही के माध्यम से संभव हुआ है 🙏हम सभी के लिए अत्यंत गर्व का विषय है एवं ये और भी महत्वपूर्ण है की हमनें ये लक्ष्य हनुमान जी के प्रिय दिवस शनिवार 22-11-2025 के दिन प्राप्त किया है। आप सबका ह्रदय से आभार ❤ 🌺🙏जय श्री हनुमान जी 🙏🌺

Jai Kapisa Tihun Lok Ujagar) Those who Chant Hanuman Chalisa Regularly with full devotion will definitely have very good Health & Wealth. Chanting the Hanuman Chalisa will relieve any kind of illness or adversity and bring Prosperity in one's life.

Album: Shree Hanuman Chalisa - Hanuman Ashtak
Singer: Hariharan
Artist: Gulshan Kumar
Composer: Lalit Sen, Chander

snippet.description:
The ultimate Malayalam hip-hop link-up of 2026 is here. Stream "Sraav" now: https://runtownone.lnk.to/sraav

Presenting the official lyric video for "Sraav" a powerhouse collaboration bringing together hit producer Thudwiser, Malayalam rap pioneer Thirumali, and breakout sensations Hanan Shaah and Eechu.

🎵 Stream "Sraav" on your favorite platforms:
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/43k1u5zTn2J29OMZbxegcX?si=BiA9X7hLSC2n5XPQUSBR2A
Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/in/song/sraav/6784005360
Amazon Music: https://music.amazon.com/albums/B0H6LKGC89?marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER&musicTerritory=US&ref=dm_sh_HHn7SRQHAYzAHD8dADQtx5g76
Gaana: https://gaana.com/song/sraav 

Audio Credits:
Track: Sraav
Producer / Composer: Thudwiser
Performance: Thirumali, Hanan Shaah, Eechu
Lyrics: Vinayak Sasikumar, Thirumali 
Mixing & Mastering: Akash Shravan 
Project Manager and A&R: Theertha Avinash 
Label: Runtown Music 

Video Credits:
Lyric Video & Typography by: Bhadra Surjith (Camoflaq) 
https://www.instagram.com/camoflaq

Lyrics: 
അതിരെഴാ 
കടലാഴം 

അതില് നിൻ ചാവ് 

തിരയടിക്കണ താളത്തിൽ തുടിക്ക് 
മനസ്സിന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ ആരവം നിറച്ച് 
പൊരുതി തെളിഞ്ഞ നായകൻ കണക്ക് 
വാളിന്റെ മുനക്കൊത്ത വാചക കസർത്ത് 
അധിക പ്രസംഗം നാവിൽ നിറച്ച് 
പടയൊരുക്കത്തിൽ രാവണൻ കണക്ക് 
കടലെടുത്തൊരു കാട്ടിലെ കയത്തിലെ സ്രാവിന് സമമൊത്തോരാൾ തലയെടുപ്പ് 

അതിരെഴാ 
കടലാഴം 

അതില് നിൻ ചാവ് 

എതിരിടാൻ വലവീശ് 
തുരത്തിടും സ്രാവ് (x2)

SWITCH!

ഒരുവൻ ഒരു ദിനം, ഒരു ലക്ഷ്യം 
ഒരുനാൾ വരും ഇവനൊരു പക്ഷം 
കലികാലത്തിൽ ഉടയവനിഷ്ടം 
വരമായി കിട്ടിയതോ ദൃഷ്ടാന്തം 
അരമനകളിൽ നിറയുന്ന ദേവാമ്ശം 
അടിവയറിനു അറിയില്ല വേദാന്തം 
അവനുടെ ഇരു മിഴികളിൽ നിറയുന്ന തീനാളം അതിനുറവിടം പാതാളം. 
തുടി തുടിക്കുന്ന മനസ്സിന്റെ ആഭാസം 
കരയടുക്കുന്ന വരെ ഇതൊരാചാരം 
മണൽ തരികളിൽ തിരയുടെ ശീൽകാരം 
മറുകരയിലൊരസുരന്റെ ആക്രോംശം 
അടിമുടി ഇത് തസ്‌ക്കര വ്യവഹാരം 
കൺകെട്ട് കനം മായാജാലം 
അലമുറയിട്ട് കരയണ്ട കേൾക്കില്ല കടലിന്റെ കരുത്തിനൊത്താവില്ല അഹംഭാവം

snippet.description:
✅ High-Stakes Showdown: Portugal vs. Spain | FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 Simulation

Witness an epic Iberian Derby in the Round of 16 as Portugal clashes with Spain in this intense FIFA World Cup 2026 showdown, fully simulated in EA Sports FC 26! With a coveted spot in the Quarter-Finals on the line, the stage is set for a legendary battle. Portugal enters the pitch with a perfect blend of seasoned greatness and attacking flair, ready to assert their dominance. Standing in their way is a mesmerizing, tactical Spanish side—renowned for their elite midfield control and explosive wing play.

More than just a match, this is a showcase of generational brilliance. Portugal's charge is led by the timeless motivation of Cristiano Ronaldo (CR7) alongside the brilliant playmaking of Bruno Fernandes. snippet.description:
😱 Franklin & Shinchan Save Los Santos from Giant Mosquito Attack! | GTA 5 Malayalam

Franklin, Shinchan, and Aju set out on a normal bike ride through Los Santos, but something feels strange—the entire city is empty! Suddenly, giant mosquitoes begin chasing them across the streets in one of their biggest adventures yet.

After escaping home, they discover mysterious mosquito eggs floating in their swimming pool. When Michael arrives injured, Franklin realizes the Giant Mosquito Queen is behind the attack. With the help of Dr. Jatka, they create an epic plan using blood bags, mosquito eggs, and a giant bat trap to save Los Santos from the terrifying Giant Mosquito Attack.

Will Franklin and Shinchan defeat the Giant Mosquito Queen and save the city? Watch till the end for an action-packed, funny, and thrilling GTA 5 Malayalam adventure!
